note: Large-budget matched comparison. Stops on a TOKEN budget so the registered 1,000,000-token ceiling is exact. One epoch, no row revisited, so a null result cannot be attributed to cycling a small set. Open splits only; DEV and TASK are bit-identical to outputs/splits. No receipt, no gate, no sealed data, no efficacy claim.
comparability: Matched WITHIN this run (same recipe, splits, seeds, device, dtype for every arm). NOT directly comparable to the 40-step CPU FP32 runs unless device and dtype match them.
optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-05 wd=0 clip=1.0 accum=8 micro_batch=1
schedule: linear warmup 3% then cosine to 10% of peak, driven by token count so a resume lands on the same schedule
metric_note: Only ~10% of a row is the assistant reply; the rest is system prompt, user turn and chat-template boilerplate. dev_ce_nats is over ALL target positions and is therefore dominated by boilerplate. dev_response_ce_nats restricts to the reply. Both are reported because neither alone has been shown to track capability in this programme.
